request.prompt:
Author exactly ONE complete whole-body pose of this exact WHITE ALBINO APE, on a transparent canvas with broad padding on every side. Reference1 bottom-row first creature is original identity; reference2 shows this same authored model, use its E/right-facing figure for consistency. Preserve huge white shaggy shoulders/back/arms, bluish-grey bare muscular chest/face/belly, red eyes, black muzzle, white fangs, short bent hind legs, very long muscular arms ending in dark grey knuckles and toes. No clothes, equipment, tail, horns, extra limbs or new body design. Detailed painted 2D RPG game sprite as original, not a different yeti/cartoon. Face EAST/RIGHT profile at the same isometric camera elevation, only ONE figure. The near visible left arm/left hind leg and far right arm/right hind leg must remain anatomically connected from torso through shoulder/hip/elbow/knee/wrist/ankle into knuckles/toes. All fingertips, fur and toes fully inside canvas with at least10% margins. Alpha ZERO outside character, no ground shadow, floor, glow, effects, background, text or labels. Keep the same original head/shoulder/torso/arm/leg proportions, original arm length and head size. Real articulated joints and whole-body weight transfer, not a copied rotated/scaled/translated still. Near means the visible camera-side arm, far means the other arm.
Walk phase2 FAR PASS: far right upper arm/elbow/wrist swings FORWARD RIGHT, far hand raised just above ground; near left arm supports under/rear chest. Near left hind knee/foot advances forward while far right hind foot pushes backward. Both arm chains and both hind legs clearly attached, small weight shift.
Only ONE independent complete figure, not a sheet or multiple poses.
